_bootstrap: Starting point for an EMPTY cluster, not the source of truth. The truth is the ConfigMap in the cluster — a deploy never applies this file. See k8s/board.yaml.
_comment: `demo` is the fixture the conformance suite runs against — it must exist in any board the suite is to test. Everything else here is an example: replace the project names with your own.

_example-project._comment: Grants are per (harness@host, project). `harness@*` is any machine; `*` is the fallback for everyone else. An agent can never grant itself anything — DESIGN.md §3.7.

_budget: Ceilings per QUOTA WINDOW, using the window name the harness itself reports (5h/7d for Claude Code). The owner's decision — if the ceiling for a window an agent reports is missing, that agent stops. `fallback` applies to harnesses that do not report quota at all: max tasks per session.
